data.notes: Confirmed June 2027 music-travel picks are concentrated in early-month festival/weekender formats; several larger Malta summer brands had not yet published specific June 2027 programmes.

events.title: Earth Garden Festival 2027
events.summary: Malta’s long-running alternative music festival is confirmed for 4 to 6 June 2027. The official site has the dates live but had not yet published a 2027 lineup at the time of research.

events.title: Sidewinder Malta 2027
events.summary: A four-day destination weekender from the Sidewinder brand, built around six events, a full adults-only hotel takeover, club nights, beach parties and pool parties for UKG/R&B-led nightlife travellers.

events.title: Euphoria Weekender Malta 2027
events.summary: Seven-day trance-focused weekender running from 26 May to 1 June 2027, with listed artists including Lange, Ian Van Dahl, Rob Tissera, Roger Shah, Agnelli & Nelson and XiJaro & Pitch. The June date listed in the itinerary is Tuesday 1 June at Beachaven Club.

events.title: Pukka Up Malta Boat Party | Party Hard Travel
events.summary: A summer-long Saturday boat-party series from the touring Pukka Up brand, billed with Pukka Up DJs playing house, tech house and party anthems on a four-hour sunset cruise.
